Useful boundary
Water-to-delivered dry pressurizedH2 is a full operation including electrodes/carrier, gas acceptance, drying/compression, thermal state, preparation, replacement and shutdown. The underlying complete-ammonia ledger is not a demonstration of a new hydrogen module.
In the available conditional ammonia design,11.5->10kWh/kg saves only0.075USD/kg at0.05USD/kWh. Waiving its0.505USD/kg initial capital recovery leaves0.998USD/kg with its other costs unchanged; capital is therefore material, but no free factory/life follows.

Actually read component precedent
The initial main pp786--789 of Dotan etal2019 E-TAC, DOI10.1038/s41560-019-0462-7, describe cobalt-doped nickel-hydroxide electrochemical charging with hydrogen evolution and hotter chemical regeneration with oxygen release. Small100s/100s cycles used ambient/95C alkaline baths and a platinized benchmark cathode. Reported low cell work is electrical-only. This supplies a real separated-reaction operation, not complete heat recovery, pressurized gas handling, lifetime or plant cost.
The exact authorPDF https://canli.dicp.ac.cn/hqq.pdf subsequently failed BOTH first governing heat/Methods finds with400Timeout. SAME paper identity is HELD against further lookup/alternate/provider/version/www normalization/title/SI/export.
